entries.title: Psalms 136:1

entries.title: Psalms 136:24
segments: 24. And hath redeemed us--or, literally, "snatched us"--alluding to the sudden deliverance effected by the overthrow of Babylon.

entries.title: Psalms 136:25
segments: 25. To the special favors to His people is added the record of God's goodness to all His creatures (compare

segments: ) before the captivity.  It is used by the later writers as specially distinguishing God from idols.
